what: Waterfall branches on wrapper rc but CI launchers report agent failure via LAUNCHER_EXIT while exiting 0
scenario_or_breakage: A failed Cursor/Codex/Claude agent is treated as tier success, so the cascade does not fall through and post-success commit/push logic can run after a failed vendor attempt
suggested_fix: Parse LAUNCHER_EXIT from the launcher stdout capture and treat non-zero LAUNCHER_EXIT as tier failure; add tests where wrapper rc is 0 but LAUNCHER_EXIT is non-zero
